title: Attribution

location.series: IBM Logo and Brand Guidelines for Third Parties / copyright 2022

slide_intent: Give trademark ownership an explicit textual form, so audiences can distinguish a referenced brand from the owner of the communication.
strategic_value: A consistent attribution statement can preserve clear IBM ownership alongside third-party messaging.
demonstration: The Attribution heading sits beside a short placement instruction and a labeled template statement with an IBM Brand placeholder.
practical_value: Place the supplied attribution in the communication or its legal section where space permits.

content_islands.name: Attribution heading
content_islands.spec: Set the heading in the left column.

content_islands.name: Placement and template
content_islands.spec: Place the space-qualified instruction above the Proper attribution statement label and the bracketed brand-name template.

reference_purposes.Application: The page supplies an attribution template and two possible locations for it.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The instruction is explicitly qualified by where space permits; the template identifies IBM Corp. ownership in the US or other countries or both.
